_doc: EAP (Edition/Artifact Package) delivery/build manifest registry (A4, BI-PF-0397). Owner: core/packaging.py. Declares the known EAP schema version(s) and their compatibility ranges. BUILD-TIME only: the EAP is how Product Forge decides what goes into a package; it is NOT shipped to customers (the shipped artifact is the EAP's output, not the EAP).
